prompt: Background music for a calm premium tech launch film that runs through one night and ends at sunrise. 120 BPM. Opens nocturnal and intimate: soft ticking clock-like hi-hats, warm muted Rhodes chords, deep round sub bass, gentle pulse. Builds momentum steadily as the night passes, with a light four-on-the-floor kick entering around 4 seconds and plucky arpeggios stacking up, getting tighter and brighter toward 12 to 14 seconds. At 14 seconds a warm sunrise lift: bright open synth pads, shimmering bells, the whole mix opens up and turns hopeful. Resolves on a confident happy final chord at 22 seconds. Instrumental only.
